news.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
news.body: Explore OpenAI Signals data on 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how people use ChatGPT for work and how usage changes over time.

news.title: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
news.body: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.

news.title: Google 回顾 AI 结核病筛查从研究走向基层的进展
news.body: 文章介绍胸部影像筛查、前瞻性临床研究及与当地合作伙伴推进部署的路径，也讨论 MedGemma 等开放模型。筛查用于发现需要进一步检测的人群，不能等同于单凭 AI 确诊或各地区均已获准使用。
news.title_original: Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening

news.title: Martha Minow 在 MIT 讨论 AI 与民主的关系
news.body: 讲座从教育、公民参与和制度信任等角度讨论 AI 可能带来的侵蚀与支持作用。这是法律学者的公共论述，不应当作已获因果验证的统一社会结论。
news.title_original: At MIT, Martha Minow speaks on sustaining democracy, both by using and overcoming AI
news.body_original: In Compton Lecture, the distinguished legal scholar warns of potential “loss of the Enlightenment” while suggesting ways innovations can meet our civic and cultural needs.

news.title: OpenAI 介绍 Habitat 在线存储的扩展经验
news.body: 文章讨论 Cosmos DB 多租户隔离、数据移动、热点限流及全球缓存等设计权衡。经验来自其自身大规模工作负载，不意味着相同架构适用于所有系统。
news.title_original: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.

news.title: LitPivot 让研究构想随文献证据迭代
news.body: 系统围绕提案正在编辑的部分组织文献，以原文片段支持批评与修改建议。17 名研究者参与的研究显示文献扎根性改善，但样本有限，主观新颖性感受不等于研究贡献已被证实。
news.title_original: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape

news.title: MIT 人文社科学院周年活动讨论 AI 与人的理解
news.body: 报道回顾 9 月研讨会中对人文学科、教育和技术社会影响的讨论。内容是学术活动观点汇集，不是新的 AI 性能或社会效果实验。
news.title_original: Reinforcing the value of human understanding at MIT
news.body_original: During the School of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences’ 75th Anniversary Symposium, President Sally Kornbluth said “MIT has never needed your particular insight and guidance more than we do now.”

news.title: OpenAI 介绍前沿模型训练环境的隔离加固
news.body: 文章回顾研究环境中的边界突破与红队测试，介绍断网训练和多层防护。训练评估环境不同于客户产品，这些措施也不代表隔离风险已完全消除。
news.title_original: Securing our frontier model training environment
news.body_original: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

news.title: MIT 访谈回顾 AI 对复杂人类思维的建模历史
news.body: 历史学者讨论早期研究者为何把随机性引入逻辑计算，并将其与创造力和可预测性的权衡联系起来。这是历史研究与解释视角，不是证明所有现代幻觉都无法避免的技术结论。
news.title_original: Q&A: How AI came to model the “messy” human mind
news.body_original: Assistant Professor Benjamin Lindquist studies how engineers deliberately injected randomness into early AI, giving rise to deep-learning models that sometimes hallucinate.

news.title: OpenAI 与波兰 NASK 探索 AI 安全研究合作
news.body: 双方签署协议，拟共同研究能力评估、潜在漏洞与防护机制。合作方向与既有安全案例不代表所有新系统已经获得独立安全认证。
news.title_original: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
news.body_original: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK are partnering on AI safety, security, and technical research to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem.

news.title: TorchNeuron 提供 Trainium 模型兼容性查询
news.body: 支持页面列出指定软件版本下的测试结果、运行脚本、编译在内的耗时与显存。尚未测试不等于不兼容，当前覆盖的任务与模型范围仍有限。
news.title_original: Does Your Model Run on AWS Trainium? Look It Up

news.title: ThinkingBox 把数据库最终状态检查用作训练奖励
news.body: 团队用基准之外的任务训练智能体，通过可执行结果评价完成情况。报告提升来自指定模型与训练配置，不能等同于所有真实业务任务都可靠完成。
news.title_original: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox

news.title: OpenAI 宣布 Decisions API 正式可用
news.body: 服务面向分类、路由等答案范围有限的决策，支持文本、图像和结构化输入。速度与成本优势取决于任务和比较条件，仍应评估错误及低置信度情况。
news.title_original: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
news.body_original: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.

news.title: X-Hinges 为交互式打印物件嵌入传感与导线
news.body: 软件将不同材料用于传感器和连接线路，以减少信号干扰，支持响应动作的打印物件原型。文中的感知能力不意味着设备具有意识，实际精度仍需按设计验证。
news.title_original: This design software reimagines everyday objects as self-aware devices
news.body_original: “X-Hinges” helps design and 3D print items like lamps and gloves with an interactive twist: automatically embedded sensors that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.

news.title: Granite 用四种时间序列模型集成预测
news.body: 方案组合四种互补架构，提供中位数与分位数预测，无需重训或拟合集成权重。不同序列仍需比较表现，首次运行需下载成员模型。
news.title_original: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models

papers.title: 机器学习光学模型解析埋藏界面的分子状态
papers.body: arXiv:2610.31924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phenomena responsible for emerging technologies originate from novel molecular states at buried interfaces. Yet quantitatively resolving these features is out of reach in most cases. Resonant scattering has demonstrated sensitivity to these local states but is limited due to a lack of accurate interpretive models. We leverage a machine learning (ML)-optimized optical model to analyze polarized resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) from molecular thin films. This new analysis establishes the direct and quantitative interpretation of molecular orientation, chemical identity and packing states as a function of depth with sub-monolayer resolution

papers.title: 整合晶体数据库重新审视筛选与逆向设计边界
papers.body: arXiv:2610.32678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal materials are designed either by screening known crystals for a target property or by generating new crystals with that property. Both routes are judged against public databases of known crystals, but these databases name the same crystal differently. Several materials announced as new by recent generative and autonomous discovery campaigns have since proved to be known phases or close variants of them. The limits of both routes remain unmeasured. Here we probe them by matching the crystals of 55 databases by structure into one self-extending database of 14.6 million crystals and 131.8 million property values, each traced to its source.
papers.summary: 预印本摘要：研究通过结构匹配整合多库信息，分析缺失性质与生成候选的新颖性。指定刚度任务中生成和筛选的比较揭示重复及组分偏好，不能推断生成设计在所有任务都无效。
